admin_head: 63 Ministère de la Communication, des Télécommunications et du Numérique
spending_entity: Ministère de la Communication, des Télécommunications et du Numérique
purpose: The ministry's digital-economy programme: transfers to the state digital agency and start-up support, and digital investment, excluding staff costs.
scope_basis: A programme of the digital ministry whose title and content are the digital economy and the digitalisation of the administration; the ministry's media, postal and administration programmes are separate and not held.
amount_scale: billions of FCFA to two decimals, as the RTEB annexe prints it (comma decimals); stored normalised to units
doc_locator: RTEB 4e trimestre 2024, Annexe 2 (situation d'exécution par ministère, programme et catégorie au 31 décembre 2024), PDF p. 5, section Ministère de la Communication, des Télécommunications et du Numérique, programme Economie numérique, columns LFI and Crédits PEC, categories 3, 4, 5 and 6
notes: Domestic credits excluding personnel: the annexe prints only internally financed, non-personnel credits (its LFI column totals 2,811.57bn, which is the LFI's other current spending 1,676.9 plus capital on internal resources 1,134.7). Categories: goods and services 0.06, current transfers 5.85, investment 2.68, capital transfers 3.00 = 11.59bn voted; opened 12.21; engaged, liquidated and ordonnanced 11.97; PEC 11.96. Reconciliation: LFI 2024 Annexe III (as restated in the LFR 2024 Annexe III, PDF p. 72) prints the programme at 16,101,606,876 all sources, of which personnel 229,781,000 (not held here), goods and services 61,610,651, transfers 5,850,000,000, investment 6,960,215,225 and capital transfers 3,000,000,000; categories 3, 4 and 6 equal the annexe, so the externally financed part is investment only, about 4.28bn (external.csv). The migrated row's 16.1bn was this all-sources programme total from press reporting; it is corrected to the domestic figure. Revised: the LFR 2024 (Loi 2024-16) cuts the programme to 13,903,727,489 all sources but prints no origin split, so no revised stage is held; the execution rate is against the initial vote and the opened credits (12.21bn) include carry-overs. Actual is provisional pending the 2024 settlement law. Publisher copies fetched 2026-09-24 match OSINT's artefact md5 (a2t424 cb5c3257, lfr24 c08a49b6).

admin_head: 33 Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité publique
programme: ELABORATION DE CARTES D'ELECTEUR ET DE CARTES D'IDENTITE BIOMETRIQUE - Phase 2
line_name: Elaboration de cartes d'électeur et de cartes d'identité biométrique - Phase 2
purpose: Production of biometric national identity cards that double as voter cards, second phase.
scope_basis: A named chapter for biometric identity-card production; the same card serves as the voter card, so electoral logistics may sit in the line and cannot be separated.
doc_locator: Loi n° 2023-18 (LFI 2024), Annexe XII Liste des projets financés sur les recettes d'hydrocarbures, PDF p. 153, Ministère de l'Intérieur, Transferts en capital; revised from Loi n° 2024-16 (LFR 2024), Annexe XII modifié, PDF p. 100
notes: Baseline is proposed: the tabled bill (PLF 2024 Annexe XII, PDF p. 153) prints the same 2,000,000,000. Funded from hydrocarbon revenue, which the law lists as its own annexe, so the origin is domestic. The LFR restates the line at 1,000,000,000 (a restated total, not an increment). Cross-foot: the LFI annexe's 24 chapters sum to its printed 49,283,181,220 and the LFR's to 28,347,897,610. The annexe names the ministry but not the programme; the 2026 DPPD places phase 2 in programme 2012 Gouvernance électorale. Held as a chapter of the Interior section, which holds no other row. Publisher copies fetched 2026-09-24 match OSINT's artefact md5 (lfi24 3845d4e0, lfr24 c08a49b6, plf24 a4bb971c).
